title: Policy
note: The manifest for the policy area. Akoma Ntoso has no policy document type, so a policy is carried as <doc name="regulations"> under policy/akn/ - <doc> is the element the standard provides for a document type it does not name. It would be <act> once notified into force. The source PDF sits one folder over in policy/sources/ and the checked transcription in policy/md/, which is what the converter reads. The Policy page is generic over this list - to add a document, drop its files in, add an entry here and run scripts/convert_policy_akn.py. `unit` is how that document numbers itself, so a citation reads in the document's own language rather than in ours.

documents.status_note: Published for comment on 3 June 2026, comments invited until 20 June 2026. Not in force: regulation 1(2) commences it only on a notification by the Chief Justice of India for the Supreme Court, and by the Chief Justice of each High Court for the courts under it.
